summary: Jansen Techniek is a family business in Putten, Netherlands, that designs, builds and installs machines, automation and robotics for the food industry, including custom machines for potato production. It also resells weighing, sorting, metal detection and magnetic separation equipment from partner brands. It was founded in 1997 by Jannes and Ria Jansen.
machines: JT Kistenkantelaar: hydraulic tipper for various container types, up to 1,000 kg
JT Basic Kantelaar: simpler tipper for one Dolav crate, two-hand control
JT crate stacker and de-stacker: stacks and de-stacks crates
JT turntable: turntable for product handling
Fortress belt metal detector: detects and rejects ferrous and non-ferrous metals
Custom-built machines: designed to suit the customer's potato production problem
markets: Worldwide, from Iceland to Chile and from Vietnam to Canada
facts: Founded in 1997 as a sole proprietorship, starting in an old chicken barn
Mechanics available 24/6, on site or remotely
Fortress metal detectors supplied in the Netherlands and Belgium by Jansen Control Systems

contact.address: Jansen Techniek, Jan Nijenhuisstraat 12-14, 3882 HS Putten, Netherlands

limitations: The potato page names no potato machine models, capacities, sorting technology or potato customers; most published machines and cases are for meat, fish, poultry, bakery and dairy.
